text:
**14 March 2025 (Meridian Brief)** - Peverell Semiconductors laid off 1,200 staff, the company announced Friday.

The cuts equal about 18% of Peverell's 6,700-person global workforce.

Chief Executive Officer Marguerite Oyelaran-Finch confirmed the reductions on an investor call held the same day. The company also submitted a Form 8-K restructuring filing on 14 March, which sets out the cuts.

People familiar with the matter said the filing and the call were coordinated so that investors and affected employees would hear the news at roughly the same time.

Peverell has not announced further reductions. Details of how the cuts will be spread across its operations are expected to emerge as the restructuring proceeds, those people said.
